description.zh:
* 需要抽取的所有Key（字符串数组）。
* 默认值为**空**，表示由大模型自动判断需要抽取的Key。
* Key的上限数量为**30**（包含30）。
* 建议调用接口时传此参数，减小接口耗时。**请注意**：接口响应时间和Key的数量呈正相关关系。
description.en:
* An array of strings specifying all keys to be extracted.  
* Default value is **empty**, which means the LLM automatically determines the keys to extract.  
* The maximum number of keys allowed is **30** (inclusive).  
* It is recommended to pass this parameter when invoking the API to reduce duration. **Note**: The response time is positively correlated with the number of keys.

description.zh:
* 本字段和 body 字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超过2048字节，不支持 base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you cannot pass both or leave both empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length and does not support base64).

description.zh:
* 本字段和 URL 字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大 10MB。
* 使用 HTTP 方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到 HTTP body 中上传即可。
* 使用 SDK 的方式调用，把图片放到 SDK 的 body 中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you cannot pass both or leave both empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When calling via HTTP, upload the image binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 如何使用本接口 | 步骤 | 概述 | | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 1 | 开通 [OCR 统一识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_unity_public_cn) 服务。本接口在公测阶段，是免费接口，开通后即可调用。 | 3 | 可以参照[调试页面](https://api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeGeneralStructure?sdkStyle=dara) 提供的代码示例完成 API 接入开发。接入完成后，调用 API 获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对 RAM 账号进行授权。创建 RAM 用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建 RAM 用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为 RAM 用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html) | #### 重要提示 | 类型 | 概述 | | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 图片格式 |
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、PDF、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。
| | 图片尺寸 |
  • 图片长宽需要大于 15 像素，小于 8192 像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于 50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于 500px。
| | 图片大小 |
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过 10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于 1.5M 图片进行识别，且通过传图片 URL 的方式调用接口。
| | 其他提示 |
  • 请保证整张图片内容及其边缘包含在图像内。
  • 本能力会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
  • PDF类型文件仅识别第一页。
| ---
descriptions.en:
#### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 1 | Activate the [OCR Unified Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_unity_public_cn) service. This API is in public preview and is free to use. You can invoke it immediately after activation. | | 3 | You can refer to the code sample provided on the [debug page](https://api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeGeneralStructure?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration development. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to invoke the API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For detailed steps on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For specific authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Image Format |
  • This API supports the following formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, PDF, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width of the image must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve better recognition results, we recommend that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Large images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB for recognition and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • Ensure that the entire content of the image, including its edges, is contained within the image frame.
  • This capability automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but this may impact accuracy. Whenever possible, use images with high definition, no glare, and no distortion.
  • For PDF files, only the first page is processed.
| ---
